turbo_Action.actionID.justification: Action IDs and release IDs are directly related as unique identifiers for actions or releases.
Action IDs and application association IDs are related through their role in identifying specific actions or releases.
Action IDs and application IDs in build artifact associations are conceptually linked through their identification roles.
Action IDs and release IDs within application collections are related through their identification and association roles.
Action IDs and release IDs are conceptually related as they both serve as unique identifiers for specific entities or actions.
